cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The jam has my permission to leave. Have you found room for it in your suitcase?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I leave it here? There's no room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may reorganize. Open the case; I'll approve what comes out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fits now. Can I go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The arrangement is approved. Lift it onto the bed; I haven't cleared you to carry all that weight.

reason: Retain packing as the delay but make A's approval govern every attempted exit. B4 solves capacity, causing A5 to extend approval to the weight of the now-full case.
